providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): New Horizons resolved detail down to ~3 km/pixel on Nix during its single 2015 flyby — enough to see its shape and one notable red crater, but not enough for a controlled global photomosaic. Procedural texture parameterized directly on that real feature: bright neutral base plus one isolated reddish patch, matching Showalter et al. 2015's reported red blotch around an impact crater on Nix's otherwise grey, water-ice surface.
